candidate_tools.name: list_issues
candidate_tools.description: Filter issues by structured fields (status, assignee). Does not search text; to find issues by topic or keyword, use search_issues.

status.description: One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. open: not started. in_progress: someone is actively working on it. blocked: waiting on something. closed: done.

include_comments.description: Include full comment threads, roughly 1 to 2K tokens per issue. Defaults to true. Set false when only titles and status are needed.

candidate_tools.name: search_issues
candidate_tools.description: Full-text search over issue titles and bodies. Use when the user describes issues by topic or keyword. To filter by status or assignee, use list_issues.

candidate_tools.name: get_issue
candidate_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.
